units.source_text: 岛村长时间地偷看叶子，却没有想到这样做会对她有什么不礼貌，

en.t: Shimamura watched Yoko secretly for a long time, yet it did not occur to him that doing so might be rude to her.

units.source_text: 他大概是被镜中暮景那种虚幻的力量吸引住了。

en.t: He was probably held fast by the unreal power of the evening scene reflected in the mirror.

units.source_text: 也许岛村在看到她呼唤站长时表现出有点过分严肃，

en.t: Perhaps, when Shimamura saw her call out to the stationmaster, she seemed a little too serious.

units.source_text: 从那时候起就对她产生了一种不寻常的兴趣。

en.t: From that moment on, he began to feel an unusual interest in her.
